findings.explanation: Only the Client can terminate the agreement without cause, while you do not have the same right. Because ongoing exhibitions and payments are protected upon termination, this creates a low-level imbalance.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement at any time upon sixty (60) days' prior written notice to the other party.
